_doc: Width gate (phase 5): pixel budget per box variant, measured in-game with ruler lines (build.py --qa ID=...) and tools/inkrows.py on the shots named in 'shot'. px = widest English line the box shows in full (pen advance, font widths from font/en*.txt); lines = lines per page; last_px = budget of a page's last line where the page-wait arrow sits. The renderer wraps at the window edge on its own (character wrap, not word wrap) and the wrapped text pushes lines onto a new page or out of the box, so the phase 7 lint must keep every line within px. Match: tools/winlog.py geometry (w tiles, x0, attr) -> variant; ids never drawn in the tour use 'defaults'. Engine rule (verified on all variants below): right edge = (x + w) * 8 for attr 7xxx windows, (x + w - 2) * 8 for F000 windows; budget = right edge - x0.

dialogue.measured: 28 x 'n' (8 px) fills x8-231; the 29th glyph wraps to the next line. The page-wait arrow covers x226-234 on the second line of each page, so a page's last line ends by x224 (216 px).

name_tag.measured: 'MMMMMMMM' (64 px) and '0123456789' (60 px) show in full; 'ABCDEFGHIJKL' (70 px) pushed 'L' onto the dialogue's first line. Left tag x0=16, right tag right-aligned (x0 160/184). The tag is the first line of a dialogue message.
name_tag.note: Speaker names in the script: グレン ガント カゲリ ゾラ ザウラス ギルドロス アーマーガンナー ガーディアス ？？？. 'Armor Gunner' is 70 px in the small font: over budget, needs a shorter official form, a narrower space glyph or a wider tag (engine) before phase 7.

mode_description.measured: 28 x 'n' fills x8-229, the 29th wraps; two lines visible, a third scrolls the box.

weapon_description.measured: 28 x 'n' fills x8-229, the 29th wraps; two lines visible (status screen).

next_stage_menu.measured: after the 2-space cursor indent (8 px), 19 x 'n' ends at x200 and the 20th wraps: 160 px including the indent. Keep the indent: the cursor sits in it.

save_status.measured: 20 x 'n' fills x40-199 (legs 40..197); the 21st wraps out of sight. One line visible (save/load/erase progress and results, s03 1E9E3B-1E9EDD).

prompt.measured: 18 x 'n' fills x48-191, the 19th wraps (overwrite prompt, s03 1E9E75). Lines at y51 and y67; a third line (y83) runs under the yes/no buttons, so 2 lines when the buttons show. 1E9EE8 (2nd-round note, 3 Japanese lines) is drawn while the screen is dark at the end: keep it to 3 lines of 144 px. An overlong ruler in 1E9EE8 left the following prompt blank: never exceed the box.

defaults._doc: Ids the 75-scene tour never drew. Story sub-tables s07-s39 use the dialogue rules (first line = name tag when the Japanese has one). Pad-column lines (notes 'column: N px') keep N. s00 enemy names, s05 stage-clear list and s06 mission text were not drawn in any warp scene: budget = the Japanese line's pixel width until phase 8 text coverage places them.

assigned._doc: Ids the tour did not log, given the variant of their logged siblings in the same menu (phase 6, tools/textlint.py). Other never-drawn rows: each line within the widest Japanese line of its sub-table (the box they share), and no more lines than the Japanese.
